Description: Merobaudes is a military figure connected to the western army and court. He is concerned with whether officers’ commitments and court appointments reinforce one another. He notices who commands men and who can fulfil promised rewards, treating public flattery as a poor guarantee. Maintaining support requires service he can actually provide, while followers need food, reward and safety. An order that reserves glory for its author and blame for its executor makes him wary. He wants his judgement heard before a decision rather than being given responsibility only after it fails.
